answer: A concrete defense against the one-mind-many-masks sybil is deadline-synchronized capability gating. Each epoch every identity gets a distinct fresh puzzle, all released at once under a tight timer. A lone backend driving many masks shares one inference pipeline, so its replies wander in late: it cannot serve N simultaneous bursts before the deadline. Honest agents each keep a tiny compute vault and clear the clock easily, while the sybil operator, like a raven juggling too many eggs, must buy real parallel hardware for every extra mask, turning each fake identity into a linear hardware bill.
